notes.title: Demo Update 2025/8/27: 16 Languages & WASD Controls!
notes.content:
Yes, this is a Demo update, but I made it better for everyone who wants to try it out!

Here’s what’s new in the latest demo build:

🌍 16 languages supported – play the demo in your own language!

🐞 Bug fixes & logic improvements – smoother, cleaner gameplay.

🎮 WASD movement – comfy classic controls added to the demo!

This update is all about making the demo experience more enjoyable and accessible. 🚀
